CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.demo_seed_analytics_status(p_lane text, p_run_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with run as (
    select * from private.demo_seed_analytics_runs
    where lane = p_lane and run_id = p_run_id
  ), layout_ids as (
    select series.i as ordinal,
      private.member_stress_uuid(
      p_run_id::text || ':analytics:layout:' || series.i
    ) as id
    from pg_catalog.generate_series(1, 60) series(i)
  ), demo_seed_ledger as (
    select ledger.user_id from private.presg_demo_ledger ledger
    where p_lane = 'presg' and ledger.run_id = p_run_id
    union all
    select ledger.user_id from private.uniondemo_ledger ledger
    where p_lane = 'uniondemo' and ledger.run_id = p_run_id
  ), eligible_members as (
    select membership.user_id, profile.chapter_id,
      (ledger.user_id is null) as primary_persona
    from run
    join public.organization_memberships membership
      on membership.organization_id = run.organization_id
     and membership.status = 'active'
    join public.member_profiles profile on profile.id = membership.user_id
    join public.member_chapter_memberships chapter_membership
      on chapter_membership.user_id = profile.id
     and chapter_membership.chapter_id = profile.chapter_id
     and chapter_membership.status = 'active'
    join public.chapters candidate
      on candidate.id = profile.chapter_id
     and candidate.organization_id = run.organization_id
    left join demo_seed_ledger ledger on ledger.user_id = membership.user_id
    order by (ledger.user_id is null) desc, membership.user_id
    limit 100
  ), selected_members as (
    select * from eligible_members
  ), event_counts as (
    select pg_catalog.count(*) * 6 as expected
    from selected_members
  ), explorer_counts as (
    select pg_catalog.count(*) as actual
    from selected_members
  ), layout_counts as (
    select
      pg_catalog.count(*) filter (where
        expected.ordinal between 1 and 30
        and layout.organization_id = run.organization_id
        and layout.owner_user_id = run.actor_user_id
        and layout.scope = 'organization'
        and layout.chapter_id is null
        and layout.name = 'Organization health view ' || expected.ordinal
        and layout.spec = pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
          'datasetId', 'organization:chapter-health',
          'chartType', (array['bar', 'stacked_bar', 'line', 'area', 'table'])[1 + (expected.ordinal % 5)],
          'title', 'Organization health view ' || expected.ordinal
        )
      ) as organization_layouts,
      pg_catalog.count(*) filter (where
        expected.ordinal between 31 and 60
        and layout.organization_id = run.organization_id
        and layout.owner_user_id = run.actor_user_id
        and layout.scope = 'chapter'
        and layout.chapter_id = run.chapter_id
        and layout.name = 'Chapter trend view ' || expected.ordinal
        and layout.spec = pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
          'datasetId', 'chapter:' || run.chapter_id || ':health-trend',
          'chartType', (array['bar', 'stacked_bar', 'line', 'area', 'table'])[1 + (expected.ordinal % 5)],
          'title', 'Chapter trend view ' || expected.ordinal
        )
      ) as chapter_layouts
    from run
    cross join layout_ids expected
    left join public.organization_analytics_layouts layout
      on layout.id = expected.id
  ), chapter_set as (
    select chapter.id
    from run
    join public.chapters chapter on chapter.organization_id = run.organization_id
  ), health_dates as (
    select (
      pg_catalog.date_trunc('month', current_date)::date
      - (series.month_offset || ' months')::interval
    )::date as measured_on
    from pg_catalog.generate_series(0, 35) series(month_offset)
  ), expected_health as (
    select chapter.id as chapter_id, health_dates.measured_on
    from chapter_set chapter cross join health_dates
  ), health_counts as (
    select pg_catalog.count(*) as expected,
      pg_catalog.count(snapshot.id) as actual,
      pg_catalog.count(distinct case when snapshot.id is not null then expected.chapter_id end) as chapters
    from expected_health expected
    left join public.chapter_health_snapshots snapshot
      on snapshot.chapter_id = expected.chapter_id
     and snapshot.measured_on = expected.measured_on
  ), sample_personas as (
    select users.id,
      users.raw_app_meta_data ->> 'sample_persona' as hat
    from auth.users users
    where p_lane = 'uniondemo'
      and coalesce(users.raw_app_meta_data ->> 'sample_persona', '')
        in ('member', 'steward', 'coordinator', 'advisor', 'admin', 'vp')
  ), persona_counts as (
    select pg_catalog.count(*) as expected,
      pg_catalog.count(distinct persona.hat) as distinct_hats,
      pg_catalog.count(*) filter (where
        exists (
          select 1 from run
          join public.member_profiles profile on profile.id = persona.id
          join public.chapters chapter
            on chapter.id = profile.chapter_id
           and chapter.organization_id = run.organization_id
          join public.organization_memberships membership
            on membership.organization_id = run.organization_id
           and membership.user_id = persona.id
           and membership.status = 'active'
          join public.member_chapter_memberships chapter_membership
            on chapter_membership.user_id = persona.id
           and chapter_membership.chapter_id = profile.chapter_id
           and chapter_membership.status = 'active'
          where not exists (
            select 1
            from public.member_roles role
            where role.user_id = persona.id
              and role.role in ('steward', 'coordinator', 'advisor', 'admin', 'vp')
              and not exists (
                select 1 from public.organization_role_grants role_grant
                where role_grant.organization_id = run.organization_id
                  and role_grant.user_id = persona.id
                  and role_grant.role = role.role
              )
          )
        )
      ) as visible
    from sample_personas persona
  )
  select pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',
      exists (select 1 from run)
      and (select organization_layouts = 30 and chapter_layouts = 30
        from layout_counts)
      and (select actual >= 50 from explorer_counts)
      and (select expected > 0 from event_counts)
      and (select event_counts.expected = (
             select pg_catalog.count(*)
             from public.organization_engagement_events event
             join run on run.organization_id = event.organization_id
             where event.source_id like run.source_prefix || ':%'
           ) from event_counts)
      and (select actual = expected and expected > 0 from health_counts)
      and (select visible = expected from persona_counts)
      and (
        p_lane <> 'uniondemo'
        or (select expected = 6 and distinct_hats = 6 from persona_counts)
      ),
    'layouts', (select organization_layouts + chapter_layouts from layout_counts),
    'organizationLayouts', (select organization_layouts from layout_counts),
    'chapterLayouts', (select chapter_layouts from layout_counts),
    'explorerMembers', (select actual from explorer_counts),
    'reportCardEvents', (select pg_catalog.count(*)
      from public.organization_engagement_events event
      join run on run.organization_id = event.organization_id
      where event.source_id like run.source_prefix || ':%'),
    'expectedReportCardEvents', (select expected from event_counts),
    'healthSnapshots', (select actual from health_counts),
    'expectedHealthSnapshots', (select expected from health_counts),
    'healthChapters', (select chapters from health_counts),
    'samplePersonas', (select expected from persona_counts),
    'distinctSamplePersonaHats', (select distinct_hats from persona_counts),
    'visibleSamplePersonas', (select visible from persona_counts)
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.demo_seed_apply_analytics(p_lane text, p_run_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET statement_timeout TO '300s'
AS $function$
begin
  perform private.lock_case_graph(array[auth.uid()], array[]::uuid[]);

begin
  perform private.lock_message_lifecycle();

declare
  organization uuid;
  actor uuid;
  chapter text;
  verification jsonb;
  prefix text := 'analytics-' || pg_catalog.substr(
    pg_catalog.md5(p_run_id::text || ':' || p_lane), 1, 12
  );
begin
  if (select auth.role()) <> 'service_role' then
    raise exception 'service_role required' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if p_lane = 'presg' then
    organization := private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':presg:organization');
  elsif p_lane = 'uniondemo' then
    organization := private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':ud:organization');
  else
    raise exception 'unknown demo lane';
  end if;
  actor := private.demo_seed_user(p_lane, p_run_id, 1);
  chapter := private.demo_seed_chapter(p_lane, p_run_id, 1);
  if not exists (
    select 1 from public.organization_memberships membership
    where membership.organization_id = organization
      and membership.user_id = actor
      and membership.status = 'active'
  ) then
    raise exception 'analytics actor is not an active organization member';
  end if;

  insert into private.demo_seed_analytics_runs (
    lane, run_id, organization_id, actor_user_id, chapter_id, source_prefix
  ) values (
    p_lane, p_run_id, organization, actor, chapter, prefix
  ) on conflict (lane, run_id) do update set
    organization_id = excluded.organization_id,
    actor_user_id = excluded.actor_user_id,
    chapter_id = excluded.chapter_id,
    source_prefix = excluded.source_prefix,
    seeded_at = pg_catalog.now();

  -- The SAMPLE website enters as one of six explicitly tagged personas. Link
  -- those pre-existing fictional identities to the statewide demo only; the
  -- Pre Solid Ground lane remains independently runnable. Every previous
  -- profile and membership value is captured before the first write so the
  -- lane's guarded teardown restores, rather than guesses, earlier state.
  if p_lane = 'uniondemo' then
    insert into private.demo_seed_analytics_persona_links (
      lane, run_id, user_id, previous_profile_chapter_id,
      previous_profile_updated_at,
      organization_membership_existed,
      previous_organization_membership_status,
      previous_organization_revoked_at,
      chapter_membership_existed,
      previous_chapter_membership_status,
      previous_chapter_revoked_at,
      previous_chapter_pinned,
      previous_chapter_last_selected_at,
      previous_chapter_joined_at
    )
    select p_lane, p_run_id, users.id, profile.chapter_id, profile.updated_at,
      (membership.user_id is not null), membership.status, membership.revoked_at,
      (chapter_membership.user_id is not null), chapter_membership.status,
      chapter_membership.revoked_at, chapter_membership.pinned,
      chapter_membership.last_selected_at, chapter_membership.joined_at
    from auth.users users
    join public.member_profiles profile on profile.id = users.id
    left join public.organization_memberships membership
      on membership.organization_id = organization
     and membership.user_id = users.id
    left join public.member_chapter_memberships chapter_membership
      on chapter_membership.chapter_id = chapter
     and chapter_membership.user_id = users.id
    where coalesce(users.raw_app_meta_data ->> 'sample_persona', '')
      in ('member', 'steward', 'coordinator', 'advisor', 'admin', 'vp')
    on conflict (lane, run_id, user_id) do nothing;

    update public.member_profiles profile
    set chapter_id = chapter, updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
    from private.demo_seed_analytics_persona_links link
    where link.lane = p_lane and link.run_id = p_run_id
      and profile.id = link.user_id
      and profile.chapter_id is distinct from chapter;

    insert into public.organization_memberships (
      organization_id, user_id, status, created_at, revoked_at
    )
    select organization, link.user_id, 'active', pg_catalog.now(), null
    from private.demo_seed_analytics_persona_links link
    where link.lane = p_lane and link.run_id = p_run_id
    on conflict (organization_id, user_id) do update
      set status = 'active', revoked_at = null;

    insert into public.member_chapter_memberships (
      user_id, chapter_id, status, pinned, last_selected_at, joined_at, revoked_at
    )
    select link.user_id, chapter, 'active', true, pg_catalog.now(),
      current_date, null
    from private.demo_seed_analytics_persona_links link
    where link.lane = p_lane and link.run_id = p_run_id
    on conflict (user_id, chapter_id) do update set
      status = 'active', pinned = true, last_selected_at = excluded.last_selected_at,
      revoked_at = null;

    insert into private.demo_seed_analytics_persona_role_rows (
      lane, run_id, user_id, role
    )
    select p_lane, p_run_id, role.user_id, role.role
    from private.demo_seed_analytics_persona_links link
    join public.member_roles role on role.user_id = link.user_id
    where link.lane = p_lane and link.run_id = p_run_id
      and role.role in ('steward', 'coordinator', 'advisor', 'admin', 'vp')
      and not exists (
        select 1 from public.organization_role_grants existing
        where existing.organization_id = organization
          and existing.user_id = role.user_id
          and existing.role = role.role
      )
    on conflict do nothing;

    insert into public.organization_role_grants (
      organization_id, user_id, role, granted_by, granted_at
    )
    select organization, owned.user_id, owned.role, actor, pg_catalog.now()
    from private.demo_seed_analytics_persona_role_rows owned
    where owned.lane = p_lane and owned.run_id = p_run_id
    on conflict (organization_id, user_id, role) do nothing;
  end if;

  -- Prefer the primary SAMPLE personas (the active organization members not
  -- owned by either bulk-load ledger), then fill the cohort with lane users.
  -- Six events per person populate the member report card while retaining a
  -- bounded, reversible source prefix.
  delete from public.organization_engagement_events event
  where event.organization_id = organization
    and event.source_id like prefix || ':%';

  with demo_seed_ledger as (
    select ledger.user_id from private.presg_demo_ledger ledger
    where p_lane = 'presg' and ledger.run_id = p_run_id
    union all
    select ledger.user_id from private.uniondemo_ledger ledger
    where p_lane = 'uniondemo' and ledger.run_id = p_run_id
  ), selected_members as (
    select membership.user_id, profile.chapter_id,
      (ledger.user_id is null) as primary_persona,
      pg_catalog.row_number() over (
        order by (ledger.user_id is null) desc, membership.user_id
      ) as ordinal
    from public.organization_memberships membership
    join public.member_profiles profile on profile.id = membership.user_id
    join public.member_chapter_memberships chapter_membership
      on chapter_membership.user_id = profile.id
     and chapter_membership.chapter_id = profile.chapter_id
     and chapter_membership.status = 'active'
    left join demo_seed_ledger ledger on ledger.user_id = membership.user_id
    where membership.organization_id = organization
      and membership.status = 'active'
      and exists (
        select 1 from public.chapters candidate
        where candidate.id = profile.chapter_id
          and candidate.organization_id = organization
      )
    order by (ledger.user_id is null) desc, membership.user_id
    limit 100
  )
  insert into public.organization_engagement_events (
    organization_id, user_id, chapter_id, event_type, source_id, occurred_at
  )
  select organization, member.user_id, member.chapter_id,
    (array[
      'meeting_check_in', 'qa_contribution', 'poll_vote',
      'survey_response', 'event_rsvp', 'authorized_contact'
    ])[event_number],
    prefix || ':' || member.ordinal || ':' || event_number,
    pg_catalog.now() - ((member.ordinal + event_number) || ' hours')::interval
  from selected_members member
  cross join pg_catalog.generate_series(1, 6) event_number
  on conflict (organization_id, user_id, event_type, source_id) do update set
    chapter_id = excluded.chapter_id,
    occurred_at = excluded.occurred_at;

  -- Seed the current rolling window immediately; the daily private refresh
  -- advances it at month boundaries and prunes only ledger-owned expired rows.
  perform private.demo_seed_refresh_analytics_health(p_lane, p_run_id);
  perform private.demo_seed_ensure_analytics_health_rotation();

  -- Thirty organization layouts plus thirty chapter layouts provide two
  -- complete 15-row pages per scope (and four combined studio pages) using
  -- the product's shared layout-page limit. Organization
  -- and chapter scopes make the rows visible to every authorized SAMPLE hat;
  -- personal layouts remain user-owned and are not fabricated for real users.
  insert into public.organization_analytics_layouts (
    id, organization_id, owner_user_id, scope, chapter_id,
    name, spec, created_at, updated_at
  )
  select private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':analytics:layout:' || i),
    organization, actor,
    case when i <= 30 then 'organization' else 'chapter' end,
    case when i <= 30 then null else chapter end,
    case when i <= 30 then 'Organization health view ' else 'Chapter trend view ' end || i,
    case when i <= 30 then pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'datasetId', 'organization:chapter-health',
      'chartType', (array['bar', 'stacked_bar', 'line', 'area', 'table'])[1 + (i % 5)],
      'title', 'Organization health view ' || i
    ) else pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'datasetId', 'chapter:' || chapter || ':health-trend',
      'chartType', (array['bar', 'stacked_bar', 'line', 'area', 'table'])[1 + (i % 5)],
      'title', 'Chapter trend view ' || i
    ) end,
    pg_catalog.now() - ((61 - i) || ' days')::interval,
    pg_catalog.now() - ((61 - i) || ' hours')::interval
  from pg_catalog.generate_series(1, 60) i
  on conflict (id) do update set
    organization_id = excluded.organization_id,
    owner_user_id = excluded.owner_user_id,
    scope = excluded.scope,
    chapter_id = excluded.chapter_id,
    name = excluded.name,
    spec = excluded.spec,
    updated_at = excluded.updated_at;

  insert into private.demo_seed_page_evidence (
    lane, run_id, surface, actual_rows
  )
  select p_lane, p_run_id, surface, actual_rows
  from (values
    ('analyticsMemberExplorer',
      (select pg_catalog.count(*)
       from (
         select membership.user_id
         from public.organization_memberships membership
         join public.member_profiles profile on profile.id = membership.user_id
         join public.member_chapter_memberships chapter_membership
           on chapter_membership.user_id = profile.id
          and chapter_membership.chapter_id = profile.chapter_id
          and chapter_membership.status = 'active'
         join public.chapters candidate
           on candidate.id = profile.chapter_id
          and candidate.organization_id = organization
         where membership.organization_id = organization
           and membership.status = 'active'
         limit 100
       ) explorer)),
    ('analyticsOrganizationLayouts',
      (select pg_catalog.count(*)
       from public.organization_analytics_layouts layout
       where layout.organization_id = organization
         and layout.owner_user_id = actor
         and layout.scope = 'organization'
         and layout.chapter_id is null
         and layout.spec ->> 'datasetId' = 'organization:chapter-health'
         and layout.id in (
           select private.member_stress_uuid(
             p_run_id::text || ':analytics:layout:' || series.i
           ) from pg_catalog.generate_series(1, 30) series(i)
         ))),
    ('analyticsChapterLayouts',
    (select pg_catalog.count(*)
     from public.organization_analytics_layouts layout
     where layout.organization_id = organization
       and layout.owner_user_id = actor
       and layout.scope = 'chapter'
       and layout.chapter_id = chapter
       and layout.spec ->> 'datasetId' = 'chapter:' || chapter || ':health-trend'
       and layout.id in (
       select private.member_stress_uuid(
         p_run_id::text || ':analytics:layout:' || series.i
       ) from pg_catalog.generate_series(31, 60) series(i)
     )))
  ) seeded_pages(surface, actual_rows)
  on conflict (lane, run_id, surface) do update set
    actual_rows = excluded.actual_rows;

  verification := private.demo_seed_analytics_status(p_lane, p_run_id);
  if not coalesce((verification ->> 'ok')::boolean, false) then
    raise exception 'analytics seed verification failed'
      using detail = verification::text;
  end if;
  return verification;
end;
end;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.demo_seed_apply_knowledge_library(p_lane text, p_run_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  perform private.lock_case_graph(array[auth.uid()], array[]::uuid[]);

begin
  perform private.lock_message_lifecycle();

declare
  org uuid;
  chapter text;
  actor uuid := private.demo_seed_user(p_lane, p_run_id, 1);
  article_id uuid;
  collection_id uuid;
  file_id uuid;
  source_id uuid;
  body text := pg_catalog.rpad(
    'Union Ground fictional knowledge resource for protected SAMPLE verification.',
    128,
    ' '
  );
  ordinal integer;
  version_number integer;
begin
  if p_lane = 'presg' then
    if not exists (
      select 1 from private.presg_demo_runs run
      where run.id = p_run_id and run.state in ('applied', 'verified')
    ) then raise exception 'presg demo run is not applied'; end if;
    org := private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':presg:organization');
  elsif p_lane = 'uniondemo' then
    if not exists (
      select 1 from private.uniondemo_runs run
      where run.id = p_run_id and run.state in ('applied', 'verified')
    ) then raise exception 'union demo run is not applied'; end if;
    org := private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':ud:organization');
  else
    raise exception 'unknown demo lane';
  end if;
  if not exists (select 1 from public.organizations row where row.id = org and row.status = 'active') then
    raise exception 'demo organization is missing';
  end if;
  chapter := private.demo_seed_chapter(p_lane, p_run_id, 1);

  for ordinal in 1..12 loop
    article_id := private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':knowledge:article:' || ordinal);
    insert into public.member_kb_articles (
      id, slug, kind, title, article_ref, body, keywords, order_index,
      chapter_id, status, is_sample, version, created_by, updated_by,
      verified_by, verified_at, updated_at, content_origin
    ) values (
      article_id,
      'knowledge-' || p_lane || '-' || pg_catalog.replace(p_run_id::text, '-', '') || '-' || ordinal,
      (array['contract', 'rights', 'faq'])[1 + ((ordinal - 1) % 3)],
      'Knowledge guide ' || pg_catalog.lpad(ordinal::text, 2, '0'),
      'Chapter knowledge · Guide ' || ordinal,
      'A realistic fictional guide with revision history for the SAMPLE knowledge workspace.',
      array['knowledge', 'workplace', 'guide']::text[],
      5000 + ordinal,
      chapter, 'published', false, 3, actor, actor, actor,
      pg_catalog.now() - interval '1 day', pg_catalog.now() - interval '1 day',
      'authored'
    ) on conflict (id) do update set
      content_origin = excluded.content_origin,
      title = excluded.title,
      article_ref = excluded.article_ref,
      body = excluded.body,
      status = excluded.status,
      version = excluded.version,
      updated_by = excluded.updated_by,
      verified_by = excluded.verified_by,
      verified_at = excluded.verified_at,
      updated_at = excluded.updated_at;

    for version_number in 1..3 loop
      insert into public.member_kb_article_revisions (
        article_id, chapter_id, version, status, kind, title, article_ref,
        body, keywords, changed_by, verified_by, verified_at, changed_at,
        content_origin
      ) values (
        article_id, chapter, version_number,
        case when version_number = 1 then 'draft' else 'published' end,
        (array['contract', 'rights', 'faq'])[1 + ((ordinal - 1) % 3)],
        'Knowledge guide ' || pg_catalog.lpad(ordinal::text, 2, '0'),
        'Chapter knowledge · Guide ' || ordinal,
        'Revision ' || version_number || ' of a realistic fictional SAMPLE knowledge guide.',
        array['knowledge', 'workplace', 'guide']::text[], actor,
        case when version_number = 1 then null else actor end,
        case when version_number = 1 then null else pg_catalog.now() - ((4 - version_number) || ' days')::interval end,
        pg_catalog.now() - ((4 - version_number) || ' days')::interval,
        'authored'
      ) on conflict on constraint member_kb_article_revisions_article_id_version_key do update set
        status = excluded.status,
        content_origin = excluded.content_origin,
        title = excluded.title,
        article_ref = excluded.article_ref,
        body = excluded.body,
        changed_by = excluded.changed_by,
        verified_by = excluded.verified_by,
        verified_at = excluded.verified_at,
        changed_at = excluded.changed_at;
    end loop;
  end loop;

  for ordinal in 1..200 loop
    file_id := private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':knowledge:file:' || ordinal);
    source_id := private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':knowledge:source:' || ordinal);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.demo_seed_apply_voice_parity(p_lane text, p_run_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET statement_timeout TO '300s'
AS $function$
begin
  perform private.lock_case_graph(array[auth.uid()], array[]::uuid[]);

begin
  perform private.lock_message_lifecycle();

declare
  v_organization_id uuid := private.member_stress_uuid(
    p_run_id::text || case when p_lane = 'presg' then ':presg:organization' else ':ud:organization' end
  );
  v_chapter_id text := private.demo_seed_chapter(p_lane, p_run_id, 1);
  v_staff_user uuid := private.demo_seed_user(p_lane, p_run_id, 1);
  v_survey_id uuid;
  v_parent_question_id uuid;
  v_session_id uuid;
  v_weekly_id uuid;
  v_state text;
  v_response_count integer;
  i integer;
  respondent integer;
begin
  if p_lane not in ('presg', 'uniondemo') then
    raise exception 'unknown demo lane';
  end if;
  if not exists (
    select 1 from public.organizations organization
    where organization.id = v_organization_id and organization.status = 'active'
  ) then
    raise exception 'demo organization is missing';
  end if;

  -- Sixteen instruments make the staff workspace feel inhabited without
  -- inventing a real organization. Every instrument carries the complete
  -- eight-type taxonomy, three sections, and one conditional follow-up.
  for i in 1..16 loop
    v_survey_id := private.member_stress_uuid(
      p_run_id::text || ':voice:survey:' || i
    );
    insert into public.organization_surveys (
      id, organization_id, chapter_id, title, description, status,
      privacy_min_responses, created_by, cadence, period_key,
      opens_at, closes_at, owner_user_id, operations_state,
      review_due_at, created_at, updated_at
    ) values (
      v_survey_id, v_organization_id, v_chapter_id,
      (array[
        'Scheduling and workload check-in',
        'Health and safety priorities',
        'Training access review',
        'Benefits communication check',
        'Workplace technology needs',
        'Shift handoff experience',
        'Member meeting accessibility',
        'Contract education interests'
      ])[1 + ((i - 1) % 8)] || ' ' || pg_catalog.lpad(i::text, 2, '0'),
      'A confidential member questionnaire about current workplace experience and chapter priorities.',
      case when i = 15 then 'draft' when i = 16 then 'closed' else 'open' end,
      5, v_staff_user, 'one_off', null,
      pg_catalog.now() - interval '30 days',
      pg_catalog.now() + interval '60 days',
      v_staff_user,
      case when i = 15 then 'draft' when i = 16 then 'complete' else 'ready' end,
      pg_catalog.now() + interval '67 days',
      pg_catalog.now() - ((40 - i) || ' days')::interval,
      pg_catalog.now() - ((18 - i) || ' hours')::interval
    )
    on conflict (id) do update set
      organization_id = excluded.organization_id,
      chapter_id = excluded.chapter_id,
      title = excluded.title,
      description = excluded.description,
      status = excluded.status,
      privacy_min_responses = excluded.privacy_min_responses,
      created_by = excluded.created_by,
      cadence = excluded.cadence,
      period_key = excluded.period_key,
      opens_at = excluded.opens_at,
      closes_at = excluded.closes_at,
      owner_user_id = excluded.owner_user_id,
      operations_state = excluded.operations_state,
      review_due_at = excluded.review_due_at,
      updated_at = excluded.updated_at;

    v_parent_question_id := private.member_stress_uuid(
      p_run_id::text || ':voice:survey:' || i || ':question:1'
    );

    insert into public.organization_survey_questions (
      id, organization_id, survey_id, sort_index, client_key, question_type,
      label, required, options, section_key, section_title,
      branch_parent_id, branch_value, scale_min_label, scale_max_label,
      max_selections
    ) values
      (v_parent_question_id, v_organization_id, v_survey_id, 0, 'experience-frequency', 'radio',
       'How often has this issue affected your work recently?', true,
       '["Never","Sometimes","Often"]'::jsonb, 'experience', 'Your experience',
       null, null, null, null, null),
      (private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':voice:survey:' || i || ':question:2'),
       v_organization_id, v_survey_id, 1, 'experience-follow-up', 'paragraph',
       'Please describe what happened and what would improve the situation.', false,
       '[]'::jsonb, 'experience', 'Your experience',
       v_parent_question_id, 'Often', null, null, null),
      (private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':voice:survey:' || i || ':question:3'),
       v_organization_id, v_survey_id, 2, 'location-note', 'text',
       'Which worksite or program is most relevant?', false,
       '[]'::jsonb, 'details', 'Workplace details',
       null, null, null, null, null),
      (private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':voice:survey:' || i || ':question:4'),
       v_organization_id, v_survey_id, 3, 'priority-areas', 'checkbox',
       'Which areas should the chapter prioritize?', true,
       '["Scheduling","Workload","Safety","Training"]'::jsonb, 'details', 'Workplace details',
       null, null, null, null, 2),
      (private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':voice:survey:' || i || ':question:5'),
       v_organization_id, v_survey_id, 4, 'preferred-channel', 'dropdown',
       'How would you prefer to receive follow-up?', true,
       '["Email","Phone","Chapter meeting"]'::jsonb, 'preferences', 'Follow-up preferences',
       null, null, null, null, null),
      (private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':voice:survey:' || i || ':question:6'),
       v_organization_id, v_survey_id, 5, 'support-confidence', 'scale',
       'How confident are you that the issue can improve?', true,
       '[]'::jsonb, 'preferences', 'Follow-up preferences',
       null, null, 'Not confident', 'Very confident', null),
      (private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':voice:survey:' || i || ':question:7'),
       v_organization_id, v_survey_id, 6, 'chapter-rating', 'rating',
       'How useful has chapter support been?', true,
       '[]'::jsonb, 'preferences', 'Follow-up preferences',
       null, null, 'Needs improvement', 'Very useful', null),
      (private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':voice:survey:' || i || ':question:8'),
       v_organization_id, v_survey_id, 7, 'contact-consent', 'yes_no',
       'May a steward contact you about your response?', true,
       '[]'::jsonb, 'preferences', 'Follow-up preferences',
       null, null, null, null, null)
    on conflict (id) do update set
      organization_id = excluded.organization_id,
      survey_id = excluded.survey_id,
      sort_index = excluded.sort_index,
      client_key = excluded.client_key,
      question_type = excluded.question_type,
      label = excluded.label,
      required = excluded.required,
      options = excluded.options,
      section_key = excluded.section_key,
      section_title = excluded.section_title,
      branch_parent_id = excluded.branch_parent_id,
      branch_value = excluded.branch_value,
      scale_min_label = excluded.scale_min_label,
      scale_max_label = excluded.scale_max_label,
      max_selections = excluded.max_selections;
  end loop;

  -- One cohort remains below the five-response floor while the next crosses
  -- it. Both use complete valid responses, so the seeded report and export
  -- paths demonstrate withheld and available states against the real tables.
  for i in 1..2 loop
    v_survey_id := private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':voice:survey:' || i);
    v_response_count := case when i = 1 then 3 else 6 end;
    for respondent in 1..v_response_count loop
      v_session_id := private.member_stress_uuid(
        p_run_id::text || ':voice:survey:' || i || ':session:' || respondent
      );
      insert into public.organization_survey_sessions (
        id, organization_id, survey_id, respondent_user_id, status,
        created_at, updated_at, submitted_at
      ) values (
        v_session_id, v_organization_id, v_survey_id,
        private.demo_seed_user(p_lane, p_run_id, 10 + respondent),
        'submitted',
        pg_catalog.now() - ((14 - respondent) || ' days')::interval,
        pg_catalog.now() - ((14 - respondent) || ' days')::interval,
        pg_catalog.now() - ((14 - respondent) || ' days')::interval
      )
      on conflict (id) do update set
        organization_id = excluded.organization_id,
        survey_id = excluded.survey_id,
        respondent_user_id = excluded.respondent_user_id,
        status = excluded.status,
        updated_at = excluded.updated_at,
        submitted_at = excluded.submitted_at;

      insert into public.organization_survey_answers
        (organization_id, session_id, question_id, value, updated_at)
      values
        (v_organization_id, v_session_id,
         private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':voice:survey:' || i || ':question:1'),
         '"Often"'::jsonb, pg_catalog.now()),
        (v_organization_id, v_session_id,
         private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':voice:survey:' || i || ':question:2'),
         pg_catalog.to_jsonb('The workload changed faster than the team could adjust.'::text), pg_catalog.now()),
        (v_organization_id, v_session_id,
         private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':voice:survey:' || i || ':question:3'),
         pg_catalog.to_jsonb(('Program ' || respondent)::text), pg_catalog.now()),
        (v_organization_id, v_session_id,
         private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':voice:survey:' || i || ':question:4'),
         '["Scheduling","Workload"]'::jsonb, pg_catalog.now()),
        (v_organization_id, v_session_id,
         private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':voice:survey:' || i || ':question:5'),
         '"Email"'::jsonb, pg_catalog.now()),
        (v_organization_id, v_session_id,
         private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':voice:survey:' || i || ':question:6'),
         '4'::jsonb, pg_catalog.now()),
        (v_organization_id, v_session_id,
         private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':voice:survey:' || i || ':question:7'),
         '5'::jsonb, pg_catalog.now()),
        (v_organization_id, v_session_id,
         private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':voice:survey:' || i || ':question:8'),
         '"yes"'::jsonb, pg_catalog.now())
      on conflict (session_id, question_id) do update
      set value = excluded.value, updated_at = excluded.updated_at;
    end loop;
  end loop;

  -- Fifty active rows match two complete 25-row member pages. Two archived
  -- rows make the full staff editorial lifecycle visible without reducing the
  -- active member pool below the depth contract.
  for i in 1..52 loop
    v_weekly_id := private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':voice:weekly:' || i);
    v_state := case
      when i > 50 then 'archived'
      when i % 3 = 0 then 'published'
      when i % 3 = 1 then 'submitted'
      else 'reserved'
    end;
    insert into public.member_weekly_questions (
      id, chapter_id, user_id, week_start, body, options,
      editorial_state, editor_note, published_survey_id,
      created_at, updated_at
    ) values (
      v_weekly_id, v_chapter_id,
      private.demo_seed_user(p_lane, p_run_id, 2 + i),
      pg_catalog.date_trunc('week', pg_catalog.now() at time zone 'UTC')::date,
      (array[
        'Which scheduling topic should members discuss next?',
        'Which training topic would help most this month?',
        'Which workplace improvement should be prioritized?',
        'Which contract topic needs a short explainer?'
      ])[1 + ((i - 1) % 4)] || ' ' || pg_catalog.lpad(i::text, 2, '0'),
      '["Scheduling","Safety","Training","Benefits"]'::jsonb,
      v_state,
      case when v_state = 'reserved' then 'Held for the next chapter bulletin.'
           when v_state = 'archived' then 'Archived after the editorial cycle.'
           else null end,
      case when v_state = 'published' then private.member_stress_uuid(
        p_run_id::text || ':voice:survey:' || (1 + ((i - 1) % 16))
      ) else null end,
      pg_catalog.now() - (i || ' minutes')::interval,
      pg_catalog.now() - (i || ' minutes')::interval
    )
    on conflict (id) do update set
      chapter_id = excluded.chapter_id,
      user_id = excluded.user_id,
      week_start = excluded.week_start,
      body = excluded.body,
      options = excluded.options,
      editorial_state = excluded.editorial_state,
      editor_note = excluded.editor_note,
      published_survey_id = excluded.published_survey_id,
      updated_at = excluded.updated_at;

    insert into public.member_weekly_question_supports (question_id, user_id)
    values
      (v_weekly_id, private.demo_seed_user(p_lane, p_run_id, 10 + ((i * 2) % 60))),
      (v_weekly_id, private.demo_seed_user(p_lane, p_run_id, 11 + ((i * 2) % 60)))
    on conflict (question_id, user_id) do nothing;
  end loop;

  insert into private.demo_seed_page_evidence
    (lane, run_id, surface, actual_rows)
  values (
    p_lane, p_run_id, 'memberWeeklyQuestions',
    (select pg_catalog.count(*)
     from public.member_weekly_questions weekly
     where weekly.chapter_id = v_chapter_id
       and weekly.week_start = pg_catalog.date_trunc('week', pg_catalog.now() at time zone 'UTC')::date
       and weekly.editorial_state in ('submitted', 'reserved', 'published'))
  )
  on conflict (lane, run_id, surface) do update
  set actual_rows = excluded.actual_rows,
      recorded_at = pg_catalog.now();

  return private.demo_seed_voice_parity_status(p_lane, p_run_id);
end;
end;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.demo_seed_casework_status(p_lane text, p_run_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  prior jsonb := private.demo_seed_casework_status_pre_member_operations_20260830(p_lane, p_run_id);
  org uuid := private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || case when p_lane = 'presg' then ':presg:organization' else ':ud:organization' end);
  suppressed_welcome integer;
  unsafe_outbound integer;
  counts jsonb;
  other_ok boolean;
begin
  select pg_catalog.count(*) into suppressed_welcome
  from public.engagement_delivery_outbox delivery
  where delivery.organization_id = org and delivery.source_kind = 'welcome_campaign'
    and delivery.state = 'suppressed' and delivery.last_error_code = 'sample.seed';
  unsafe_outbound := (prior ->> 'outboundDeliveries')::integer - suppressed_welcome;
  counts := prior -> 'counts';
  other_ok :=
    (counts ->> 'strengthAnalyses')::integer >= 120
    and (counts ->> 'bargainingWorkspaces')::integer >= 50
    and (counts ->> 'bargainingProposals')::integer >= 100
    and (counts ->> 'bargainingEvents')::integer >= 300
    and (counts ->> 'deadlines')::integer >= 120
    and (counts ->> 'deadlineExtensions')::integer >= 120
    and (counts ->> 'checklistTemplates')::integer >= 120
    and (counts ->> 'checklists')::integer >= 120
    and (counts ->> 'checklistItems')::integer >= 360
    and (counts ->> 'stepTransitions')::integer >= 120
    and (counts ->> 'accessGrants')::integer >= 12
    and (counts ->> 'alerts')::integer >= 120
    and (counts ->> 'alertAcknowledgements')::integer >= 30
    and (counts ->> 'managementPeople')::integer >= 120
    and (counts ->> 'managementEntries')::integer >= 120
    and (counts ->> 'managementAddenda')::integer >= 120
    and (counts ->> 'retaliationReports')::integer >= 120
    and (counts ->> 'retaliationPatterns')::integer >= 10
    and (counts ->> 'retaliationPatternLinks')::integer >= 90
    and (counts ->> 'retaliationPatternNotes')::integer >= 10
    and (counts ->> 'intakeDrafts')::integer >= 120
    and (counts ->> 'entityLinks')::integer >= 120
    and (counts ->> 'reminders')::integer >= 120
    and (counts ->> 'auditEvents')::integer >= 120
    and (prior ->> 'featuredHistoryRows')::integer >= 120
    and (prior ->> 'restrictedCases')::integer >= 12
    and (prior ->> 'acknowledgedAlerts')::integer >= 30
    and (prior ->> 'checklistStateMismatches')::integer = 0
    and (prior ->> 'alertAcknowledgementMismatches')::integer = 0
    and (prior ->> 'bargainingPulseMismatches')::integer = 0
    and (prior ->> 'retaliationPatternChapterMismatches')::integer = 0;
  return prior || pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', other_ok and unsafe_outbound = 0,
    'outboundDeliveries', unsafe_outbound,
    'suppressedWelcomeDeliveries', suppressed_welcome
  );
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.demo_seed_casework_status_pre_member_operations_20260830(p_lane text, p_run_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_variable
declare
  organization_id uuid := private.member_stress_uuid(
    p_run_id::text || case when p_lane = 'presg' then ':presg:organization' else ':ud:organization' end
  );
  featured_steward uuid;
  result jsonb;
begin
  if p_lane not in ('presg', 'uniondemo') then
    raise exception 'unknown demo lane';
  end if;
  featured_steward := private.demo_seed_user(p_lane, p_run_id, 1);

  with counts as (

      (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.casework_strength_analyses row where row.organization_id = organization_id) as strength,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.casework_bargaining_workspaces row where row.organization_id = organization_id) as workspaces,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.casework_bargaining_proposals row where row.organization_id = organization_id) as proposals,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.casework_bargaining_events row where row.organization_id = organization_id) as bargaining_events,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.casework_deadlines row where row.organization_id = organization_id) as deadlines,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.casework_deadline_extensions row where row.organization_id = organization_id) as extensions,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.casework_checklist_templates row where row.organization_id = organization_id) as templates,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.casework_checklists row where row.organization_id = organization_id) as checklists,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.casework_checklist_items row where row.organization_id = organization_id) as checklist_items,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.casework_step_transitions row where row.organization_id = organization_id) as transitions,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.casework_access_grants row where row.organization_id = organization_id) as grants,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.casework_alerts row where row.organization_id = organization_id) as alerts,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.casework_alert_acknowledgements row where row.organization_id = organization_id) as acknowledgements,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.casework_management_people row where row.organization_id = organization_id) as management_people,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.casework_management_entries row where row.organization_id = organization_id) as management_entries,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.casework_management_addenda row where row.organization_id = organization_id) as management_addenda,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.casework_retaliation_reports row where row.organization_id = organization_id) as retaliation_reports,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.casework_retaliation_patterns row where row.organization_id = organization_id) as retaliation_patterns,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.casework_retaliation_pattern_reports row where row.organization_id = organization_id) as retaliation_links,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.casework_retaliation_pattern_notes row where row.organization_id = organization_id) as retaliation_notes,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.casework_intake_drafts row where row.organization_id = organization_id) as drafts,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.casework_entity_links row where row.organization_id = organization_id) as entity_links,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.casework_reminders row where row.organization_id = organization_id) as reminders,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.casework_audit_events row where row.organization_id = organization_id) as audit_events,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.member_cases row
       where row.organization_id = organization_id and row.steward_user_id = featured_steward) as history_rows,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.member_cases row
       where row.organization_id = organization_id and row.is_restricted) as restricted_cases,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*)
       from public.casework_checklists checklist
       where checklist.organization_id = organization_id
         and (checklist.completed_at is not null) is distinct from (
           select pg_catalog.count(*) = 3
             and pg_catalog.bool_and(item.completed_at is not null and item.completed_by is not null)
           from public.casework_checklist_items item
           where item.checklist_id = checklist.id
         )) as checklist_state_mismatches,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*)
       from public.casework_alerts alert
       where alert.organization_id = organization_id
         and (alert.status = 'acknowledged') is distinct from exists (
           select 1 from public.casework_alert_acknowledgements acknowledgement
           where acknowledgement.alert_id = alert.id
         )) as alert_acknowledgement_mismatches,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*)
       from public.casework_bargaining_events event
       where event.organization_id = organization_id
         and ((event.event_type = 'pulse' and event.pulse is null)
           or (event.event_type <> 'pulse' and event.pulse is not null))) as bargaining_pulse_mismatches,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*)
       from public.casework_retaliation_pattern_reports link
       join public.casework_retaliation_patterns pattern
         on pattern.id = link.pattern_id and pattern.organization_id = link.organization_id
       join public.casework_retaliation_reports report
         on report.id = link.report_id and report.organization_id = link.organization_id
       where link.organization_id = organization_id
         and pattern.chapter_id is distinct from report.chapter_id) as pattern_chapter_mismatches,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*)
       from public.member_notification_deliveries delivery
       where (p_lane = 'presg' and exists (
         select 1 from private.presg_demo_ledger ledger
         where ledger.run_id = p_run_id and ledger.user_id = delivery.user_id
       )) or (p_lane = 'uniondemo' and exists (
         select 1 from private.uniondemo_ledger ledger
         where ledger.run_id = p_run_id and ledger.user_id = delivery.user_id
       )))
      + (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.engagement_delivery_outbox outbound
         where outbound.organization_id = organization_id)
      + (select pg_catalog.count(*) from public.integration_webhook_deliveries delivery
         where delivery.organization_id = organization_id) as outbound_deliveries
  )
  select pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', strength >= 120
      and workspaces >= 50 and proposals >= 100 and bargaining_events >= 300
      and deadlines >= 120 and extensions >= 120
      and templates >= 120 and checklists >= 120 and checklist_items >= 360
      and transitions >= 120 and grants >= 12
      and alerts >= 120 and acknowledgements >= 30
      and management_people >= 120 and management_entries >= 120 and management_addenda >= 120
      and retaliation_reports >= 120 and retaliation_patterns >= 10
      and retaliation_links >= 90 and retaliation_notes >= 10
      and drafts >= 120 and entity_links >= 120 and reminders >= 120 and audit_events >= 120
      and history_rows >= 120 and restricted_cases >= 12
      and checklist_state_mismatches = 0 and alert_acknowledgement_mismatches = 0
      and bargaining_pulse_mismatches = 0
      and pattern_chapter_mismatches = 0 and outbound_deliveries = 0,
    'lane', p_lane,
    'runId', p_run_id,
    'counts', pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'strengthAnalyses', strength,
      'bargainingWorkspaces', workspaces,
      'bargainingProposals', proposals,
      'bargainingEvents', bargaining_events,
      'deadlines', deadlines,
      'deadlineExtensions', extensions,
      'checklistTemplates', templates,
      'checklists', checklists,
      'checklistItems', checklist_items,
      'stepTransitions', transitions,
      'accessGrants', grants,
      'alerts', alerts,
      'alertAcknowledgements', acknowledgements,
      'managementPeople', management_people,
      'managementEntries', management_entries,
      'managementAddenda', management_addenda,
      'retaliationReports', retaliation_reports,
      'retaliationPatterns', retaliation_patterns,
      'retaliationPatternLinks', retaliation_links,
      'retaliationPatternNotes', retaliation_notes,
      'intakeDrafts', drafts,
      'entityLinks', entity_links,
      'reminders', reminders,
      'auditEvents', audit_events
    ),
    'featuredHistoryRows', history_rows,
    'restrictedCases', restricted_cases,
    'acknowledgedAlerts', acknowledgements,
    'checklistStateMismatches', checklist_state_mismatches,
    'alertAcknowledgementMismatches', alert_acknowledgement_mismatches,
    'bargainingPulseMismatches', bargaining_pulse_mismatches,
    'retaliationPatternLinks', retaliation_links,
    'retaliationPatternChapterMismatches', pattern_chapter_mismatches,
    'outboundDeliveries', outbound_deliveries
  )
  into result
  from counts;

  return result;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.demo_seed_coordination_page_evidence()

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  perform private.lock_case_graph(array[auth.uid()], array[]::uuid[]);

declare
  seeded_run record;
begin
  if pg_catalog.pg_trigger_depth() > 1 then return null; end if;
  for seeded_run in
    select distinct evidence.lane, evidence.run_id,
      run.organization_id, run.chapter_id, run.section_prefix
    from inserted_page_evidence evidence
    join private.demo_seed_coordination_runs run
      on run.lane = evidence.lane and run.run_id = evidence.run_id
  loop
    insert into private.demo_seed_page_evidence (
      lane, run_id, surface, actual_rows
    ) values
      (seeded_run.lane, seeded_run.run_id, 'organizationCoordination',
        (select pg_catalog.count(*)
         from public.organization_coordination_records record
         where record.organization_id = seeded_run.organization_id
           and record.config ->> 'demoRunId' = seeded_run.run_id::text)),
      (seeded_run.lane, seeded_run.run_id, 'organizationCoordinationMessages',
        (select pg_catalog.count(*)
         from public.organization_coordination_messages message
         join public.organization_coordination_records record
           on record.id = message.conversation_id
         where record.organization_id = seeded_run.organization_id
           and record.config ->> 'demoRunId' = seeded_run.run_id::text)),
      (seeded_run.lane, seeded_run.run_id, 'publicChapterMicrositePages',
        (select pg_catalog.count(*)
         from public.public_chapter_pages page
         where page.organization_id = seeded_run.organization_id
           and page.chapter_code = seeded_run.chapter_id
           and page.section_slug like seeded_run.section_prefix || '%'))
    on conflict (lane, run_id, surface) do update

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.demo_seed_function_parity_status(p_lane text, p_run_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  prior_status jsonb := private.demo_seed_function_parity_status_pre_casework_20260830(
    p_lane, p_run_id
  );
  casework_status jsonb := private.demo_seed_casework_status(p_lane, p_run_id);
  evidence_ok boolean;
  pages_ok boolean;
  complete_page_depth jsonb;
begin
  select not exists (
    select 1
    from private.demo_seed_function_catalog catalog
    left join private.demo_seed_function_evidence evidence
      on evidence.function_id = catalog.function_id
     and evidence.lane = p_lane
     and evidence.run_id = p_run_id
    where evidence.function_id is null
       or evidence.status is distinct from catalog.coverage
       or evidence.evidence_key is distinct from catalog.evidence_key
  ) into evidence_ok;

  select not exists (
    select 1
    from private.demo_seed_page_contract contract
    left join private.demo_seed_page_evidence evidence
      on evidence.surface = contract.surface
     and evidence.lane = p_lane
     and evidence.run_id = p_run_id
    where evidence.surface is null or evidence.actual_rows < contract.minimum_rows
  ), pg_catalog.jsonb_object_agg(
    contract.surface,
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'actual', coalesce(evidence.actual_rows, 0),
      'minimum', contract.minimum_rows,
      'pageSize', contract.page_size,
      'ok', coalesce(evidence.actual_rows, 0) >= contract.minimum_rows
    )
  )
  into pages_ok, complete_page_depth
  from private.demo_seed_page_contract contract
  left join private.demo_seed_page_evidence evidence
    on evidence.surface = contract.surface
   and evidence.lane = p_lane
   and evidence.run_id = p_run_id;

  return prior_status || pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', coalesce((prior_status ->> 'ok')::boolean, false)
      and evidence_ok
      and pages_ok
      and coalesce((casework_status ->> 'ok')::boolean, false),
    'catalogEvidenceMatches', evidence_ok,
    'pageDepth', complete_page_depth,
    'casework', casework_status
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.demo_seed_retention_engine(p_lane text, p_run_id uuid, p_target_ref text, p_confirm_token text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  perform private.lock_case_graph(array[auth.uid()], array[]::uuid[]);

declare
  org uuid;
  actor uuid;
  policy_count integer;
  history_count integer;
begin
  if p_lane = 'presg' then
    perform private.presg_demo_authorize(p_target_ref, p_confirm_token);
    if not exists (
      select 1 from private.presg_demo_runs
      where id = p_run_id and state in ('applied', 'verified')
    ) then
      raise exception 'presg demo run must be applied before retention history';
    end if;
    org := private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':presg:organization');
  elsif p_lane = 'uniondemo' then
    perform private.uniondemo_authorize(p_target_ref, p_confirm_token);
    if not exists (
      select 1 from private.uniondemo_runs
      where id = p_run_id and state in ('applied', 'verified')
    ) then
      raise exception 'union demo run must be applied before retention history';
    end if;
    org := private.member_stress_uuid(p_run_id::text || ':ud:organization');
  else
    raise exception 'unknown demo lane';
  end if;

  select grant_row.user_id into actor
  from public.organization_role_grants grant_row
  join public.organization_memberships membership
    on membership.organization_id = grant_row.organization_id
   and membership.user_id = grant_row.user_id
   and membership.status = 'active'
  where grant_row.organization_id = org
    and grant_row.role = 'admin'
  order by grant_row.granted_at, grant_row.user_id
  limit 1;
  if actor is null then
    raise exception 'demo retention history requires an active organization admin';
  end if;

  insert into public.organization_retention_policies (
    organization_id, data_class, retention_days, execution_enabled,
    updated_by, created_at, updated_at
  ) values
    (org, 'organization_page_views', 180, true, actor, pg_catalog.now(), pg_catalog.now()),
    (org, 'organization_engagement_events', 365, false, actor, pg_catalog.now(), pg_catalog.now()),
    (org, 'integration_job_history', 365, false, actor, pg_catalog.now(), pg_catalog.now()),
    (org, 'public_event_rsvps', 90, true, actor, pg_catalog.now(), pg_catalog.now()),
    (org, 'deleted_chapter_tasks', 90, false, actor, pg_catalog.now(), pg_catalog.now())
  on conflict (organization_id, data_class) do update set
    retention_days = excluded.retention_days,
    execution_enabled = excluded.execution_enabled,
    updated_by = excluded.updated_by,
    updated_at = excluded.updated_at;

  insert into public.organization_retention_runs (
    id, organization_id, data_class, retention_days, mode, status,
    eligible_count, deleted_count, remaining_count, requested_by,
    authorized_by, authorized_at, authorization_expires_at, started_at,
    completed_at, failure_code, created_at
  )
  select
    private.member_stress_uuid(
      p_run_id::text || ':' || p_lane || ':retention-run:' || series.n::text
    ),
    org,
    classes.data_class,
    case classes.data_class
      when 'organization_page_views' then 180
      when 'organization_engagement_events' then 365
      when 'integration_job_history' then 365
      else 90
    end,
    case when series.n % 4 = 0 then 'manual' else 'scheduled' end,
    case when series.n % 7 = 0 then 'failed' else 'completed' end,
    18 + series.n * 3,
    case when series.n % 7 = 0 then 0 else 18 + series.n * 3 end,
    case when series.n % 7 = 0 then 18 + series.n * 3 else 0 end,
    actor,
    actor,
    timing.created_at + interval '1 minute',
    timing.created_at + interval '16 minutes',
    timing.created_at + interval '2 minutes',
    timing.created_at + interval '3 minutes',
    case when series.n % 7 = 0 then 'execution_failed' else null end,
    timing.created_at
  from pg_catalog.generate_series(1, 18) as series(n)
  cross join lateral (
    select (array[
      'organization_page_views',
      'organization_engagement_events',
      'integration_job_history',
      'public_event_rsvps',
      'deleted_chapter_tasks'
    ]::text[])[1 + ((series.n - 1) % 5)] as data_class
  ) as classes
  cross join lateral (
    select pg_catalog.now() - pg_catalog.make_interval(days => series.n * 60) as created_at
  ) as timing
  on conflict (id) do update set
    organization_id = excluded.organization_id,
    data_class = excluded.data_class,
    retention_days = excluded.retention_days,
    mode = excluded.mode,
    status = excluded.status,
    eligible_count = excluded.eligible_count,
    deleted_count = excluded.deleted_count,
    remaining_count = excluded.remaining_count,
    requested_by = excluded.requested_by,
    authorized_by = excluded.authorized_by,
    authorized_at = excluded.authorized_at,
    authorization_expires_at = excluded.authorization_expires_at,
    started_at = excluded.started_at,
    completed_at = excluded.completed_at,
    failure_code = excluded.failure_code,
    created_at = excluded.created_at;

  select pg_catalog.count(*)::integer into policy_count
  from public.organization_retention_policies p
  where p.organization_id = org;
  select pg_catalog.count(*)::integer into history_count
  from pg_catalog.generate_series(1, 18) series(n)
  join public.organization_retention_runs r
    on r.id = private.member_stress_uuid(
      p_run_id::text || ':' || p_lane || ':retention-run:' || series.n::text
    )
   and r.organization_id = org;

  return pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', policy_count = 5 and history_count = 18,
    'policies', policy_count,
    'history', history_count
  );
end;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sample_chapter_catalog()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  caller uuid := (select auth.uid());
  caller_org uuid := private.current_member_organization();
  sample_run uuid;
  catalog jsonb;
begin
  if caller is null
     or caller_org is null
     or not private.is_organization_member(caller_org) then
    return '[]'::jsonb;
  end if;

  select run.id
  into sample_run
  from private.uniondemo_runs run
  where run.state in ('applied', 'verified')
    and exists (
      select 1
      from private.uniondemo_chapters seeded
      join public.chapters chapter on chapter.id = seeded.chapter_id
      where seeded.run_id = run.id
        and chapter.organization_id = caller_org
    )
  order by run.updated_at desc, run.id
  limit 1;

  if sample_run is null then
    return '[]'::jsonb;
  end if;

  with seeded_chapters as materialized (
    select
      seeded.chapter_index,
      chapter.id,
      chapter.name,
      chapter.region
    from private.uniondemo_chapters seeded
    join public.chapters chapter on chapter.id = seeded.chapter_id
    where seeded.run_id = sample_run
      and chapter.organization_id = caller_org
  ),
  active_chapter_members as materialized (
    select
      chapter_member.chapter_id,
      chapter_member.user_id
    from public.member_chapter_memberships chapter_member
    join seeded_chapters chapter on chapter.id = chapter_member.chapter_id
    join public.organization_memberships organization_member
      on organization_member.user_id = chapter_member.user_id
     and organization_member.organization_id = caller_org
     and organization_member.status = 'active'
    where chapter_member.status = 'active'
  ),
  member_counts as (
    select member.chapter_id, pg_catalog.count(*)::integer as member_count
    from active_chapter_members member
    group by member.chapter_id
  ),
  staff_members as (
    select member.chapter_id, member.user_id
    from active_chapter_members member
    join public.organization_role_grants role_grant
      on role_grant.organization_id = caller_org
     and role_grant.user_id = member.user_id
    union
    select member.chapter_id, member.user_id
    from active_chapter_members member
    join public.member_role_chapters chapter_role
      on chapter_role.user_id = member.user_id
     and chapter_role.chapter_id = member.chapter_id
  ),
  staff_counts as (
    select staff.chapter_id, pg_catalog.count(*)::integer as staff_count
    from staff_members staff
    group by staff.chapter_id
  )
  select coalesce(pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'id', chapter.id,
    'name', chapter.name,
    'region', chapter.region,
    'memberCount', coalesce(member_count.member_count, 0),
    'staffCount', coalesce(staff_count.staff_count, 0)
  ) order by chapter.chapter_index), '[]'::jsonb)
  into catalog
  from seeded_chapters chapter
  left join member_counts member_count on member_count.chapter_id = chapter.id
  left join staff_counts staff_count on staff_count.chapter_id = chapter.id;

  return catalog;
end;
$function$
